column4: Checkout and payment are served to a logged-out visitor while every my-account route correctly redirects
column5: Requested against a running dev server with no session cookie all four account routes answer 307 to the login redirect - /my-account/ and /my-account/orders/ and /my-account/wallet/ and /my-account/addresses/ - while /cart/ and /cart/checkout/ and /payment/test-slug/ all answer 200 and render. The account routes are guarded because each one checks getAccessTokenFromContext inside getServerSideProps and returns a redirect. Checkout and payment have no such check and rely solely on the withAuth wrapper which cannot fire for them: isProtectedRoute compares router.pathname by strict equality against PROTECTED_ROUTES and neither /cart/checkout nor /payment/[slug] appears in that list. /cart/ differs - it IS in the list so the client wrapper redirects after hydration - which means the customer sees the protected shell flash before being bounced. Confirms code review issue 2 by observation.
column9: Logged out - no session cookie. Site running with NEXT_PUBLIC_SSR set to true.
column10: 1. Open a clean private window so no session cookie is present. 2. Request /my-account/orders/ and observe the 307 redirect to the login prompt. 3. Request /cart/checkout/ and then /payment/test-slug/ and observe both return 200 and render the page shell.
column11: Every authenticated-only route behaves like the account routes - redirected server side before any protected markup is produced.
column12: Checkout and payment render for an anonymous visitor and /cart/ renders briefly before the client redirect takes over.
column13: An anonymous visitor reaches the checkout and payment shells. The API still refuses the data so nothing private leaks - but the 401 that follows triggers the global logout path which presents as a confusing dead end - and the guard reads as present in code review while being inert. The /cart/ flash exposes protected chrome before the redirect.
column14: Add a server side token check to the checkout and payment handlers exactly as the account pages do - and add both paths to PROTECTED_ROUTES with prefix matching so the client wrapper stops silently no-opping. Note the fix must hold in the static export build mode where getServerSideProps does not run.
